subject: Hall-effect linear switch cross-section: MX-style top and bottom housing in profile, a linear stem descending to a small N/S magnet block at its base, a compression spring drawn as two zigzag columns flanking the stem, a thin housing floor, and a PCB strip below carrying a Hall sensor pad directly under the magnet, with a sensor callout. No contact leaf anywhere in the drawing.
motif: single-switch cross-section, assembled, with sensor callout
background: transparent (light-mode safe; previewed on the charcoal oklch(0.175 0.006 250) and legible)
notes: Assembled profile (not exploded) so the magnet-to-sensor gap is the one thing the eye lands on. Stem head cruciform above the housing (y 130 to 180) with travel chevrons; top housing trapezoid y 180 to 300 with aperture walls, LED notch and clip nubs; bottom housing y 300 to 466 with an inner wall and thin floor. Stem body x 564 to 636 runs to y 420 with straight flanks (linear); the magnet block x 574 to 626, y 420 to 444 is stroked in the splash hue with a pole division and tiny N/S glyphs. PCB strip x 300 to 900, y 496 to 518; sensor pad x 576 to 624, y 484 to 496 splash-filled with four leads and sense traces exiting left and right. Coral applied as: wash ellipse across the gap (600,470), four flux arcs from the magnet faces into the sensor plane, a dashed gap dimension with chevron ends at x 660, the focal dot+ring at the gap midpoint (600,464), the MAGNET / GAP labels, and the HALL SENSOR callout. Coral value oklch(0.70 0.15 26) chosen a hair lighter and lower-chroma than the U4T coral (0.68 0.165 28) and the stabilizer-rattle coral (0.66 0.16 30) so the three coral deep-dives in this batch stay distinguishable at gallery size; also clear of magnetic-switches-deep-dive's muted terracotta (0.62 0.10 45), which uses a related composition. Bronze theme dot at (1148,92); left-margin tier ticks at top housing, stem, magnet and PCB. All XML comments use '==' separator runs (no '--' runs) per the svg-validity.test.ts regression guard.
warnings: Labels reference IBM Plex Sans / JetBrains Mono by family name with system fallbacks; the SVG does not embed font files (family convention, matches prior hero-art).
Preview rasters were rendered with the repo's existing Playwright/Chromium install into the session scratchpad for visual QA only; nothing rasterized was written into the repo.
